variables.description: The accent shade of the current palette: `Callout` icons and outlined borders. Stronger with more contrast. The severity `Chip` dot reads it. Re-derived inside every severity scope, so `.ui-success` gets a green one.
variables.name: palette-roles/ui-palette-accent

variables.description: The border shade of the current palette: tonal `Callout` borders. Stronger with more contrast. Severity `Chip` borders read it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
variables.name: palette-roles/ui-palette-border

variables.description: The strongest shade of the current palette, the darkest in light mode and the lightest in dark mode, with the most contrast against the page: `Callout` text, the default `Button` fill when `--ui-button-accent` is unset. Severity `Chip` text reads it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
variables.name: palette-roles/ui-palette-strong

variables.description: Text color on `--ui-palette-strong`.
variables.name: palette-roles/ui-palette-on-strong

variables.description: A readable text shade of the current palette, at least `--ui-palette-text-min-lightness` in dark mode. Darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
variables.name: palette-roles/ui-palette-text

variables.description: The tonal fill of the current palette: primary and critical tonal buttons when `--ui-primary-tonal` is unset. Stronger with more contrast. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
variables.name: palette-roles/ui-palette-tint

variables.description: Text color on `--ui-palette-tint`.
variables.name: palette-roles/ui-palette-on-tint

variables.description: A faint fill of the current palette: tonal severity `Callout`s. Tonal severity `Chip`s read it. Re-derived inside every severity scope.
variables.name: palette-roles/ui-palette-tint-subtle

variables.description: A literal blue, hue 240 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.
variables.name: named-colors-no-severity-meaning/ui-blue

variables.description: A literal green, hue 145 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.
variables.name: named-colors-no-severity-meaning/ui-green

variables.description: A literal orange, hue 75 at `0.66`, the lightness of palette step 7 in every palette. No severity meaning.
variables.name: named-colors-no-severity-meaning/ui-orange

variables.description: A literal red, hue 25 at `0.53`, the lightness of palette step 9 in every palette. No severity meaning.
variables.name: named-colors-no-severity-meaning/ui-red

variables.description: Severity color for errors and destructive actions.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-critical

variables.description: Critical as a text color: the `.ui-critical` items of a `Menu`, a `.ui-critical` `Button` with no variant or `.ui-outlined`, and `del` and `.ui-del` text. `--ui-critical` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-critical-text

variables.description: Severity color for informational messages, and the dotted underline of `abbr`, `dfn`, `.ui-abbr` and `.ui-dfn`.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-info

variables.description: Info as a text color, for informational text outside an `.ui-info` scope. `--ui-info` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-info-text

variables.description: Color for invalid field borders, fills and outlines. Lifted to `--ui-invalid-min-lightness` in dark mode, so invalid borders stand out from the page with more contrast.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-invalid

variables.description: Color for validation messages and invalid labels. `--ui-invalid` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`, so it stays readable where `--ui-invalid` is lighter for borders.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-invalid-text

variables.description: Severity color for neutral messages. `--ui-gray-hue` and `--ui-gray-chroma` at `0.53`, the lightness of `--ui-gray-9`, capped at `--ui-accent-max-lightness` in light mode. The `.ui-neutral` scope derives its palette from its hue and chroma.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-neutral

variables.description: Neutral as a text color, for neutral text outside an `.ui-neutral` scope. `--ui-neutral` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-neutral-text

variables.description: Severity color for success messages.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-success

variables.description: Success as a text color, for success text outside an `.ui-success` scope, and `ins` and `.ui-ins` text. `--ui-success` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-success-text

variables.description: Severity color for warnings. Unlike the other severities it keeps its lightness with more contrast: the fill is light and takes dark `--ui-on-warning` text, and `--ui-warning-text` gets the stricter lightness limits instead.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-warning

variables.description: Text color on a `--ui-warning` fill: the warning `Badge`. White on a warning below 0.182 relative luminance and near-black above it, like `--ui-on-primary`.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-on-warning

variables.description: Warning as a text color, for warning text outside a `.ui-warning` scope. `--ui-warning` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`.
variables.name: intent-tokens/ui-warning-text

variables.description: Brand color for primary actions and accents. Derived from `--ui-primary-source` within `--ui-primary-max-lightness` and `--ui-primary-min-lightness`. Set `--ui-primary-source` to keep more contrast working, or this token to pin the color.
variables.name: primary/ui-primary

variables.description: Text color on `--ui-primary`. Derived with relative color from the primary's relative luminance (the `y` of `xyz-d65`): white on a primary below 0.182, near-black above it, so either side keeps 4.5:1 and a custom `--ui-primary` gets readable text.
variables.name: primary/ui-on-primary

variables.description: Primary as a text color: links, rich text links, `Callout` link hover, `Button` and `ButtonGroup` with `.ui-primary` and no variant or `.ui-outlined`. Defaults to `--ui-primary` with its lightness kept within `--ui-text-max-lightness` and `--ui-text-min-lightness`, and is derived again from the more-contrast primary. Set it when the primary needs another shade for text.
variables.name: primary/ui-primary-text

variables.description: Text and underline color of a visited `.ui-link` and of visited links in `.ui-rich-text`. Hover and focus keep their own color. When unset, visited links look like the others.
variables.name: primary/ui-link-visited-text-color

variables.description: Mark of a selected item that has to stand out from the page on its own: the current `Carousel` marker, the bar on the start edge of a selected `List` row, the selected tab of filled `Tabs`, the current `Stepper` and `Timeline` markers, and the done part of a `Progress` bar, a `Stepper` and a tracked `Timeline`. Defaults to `--ui-primary`. `--ui-selected` is the fill behind a selected item and may be faint.
variables.name: primary/ui-selected-strong

variables.description: Text color on `--ui-selected-strong`: the selected tab of filled `Tabs` and the number or icon of the current `Stepper` and `Timeline` markers. Defaults to `--ui-on-primary`.
variables.name: primary/ui-on-selected-strong

variables.description: Strongest text color, for headings, labels and values. Body text is `--ui-text`.
variables.name: text/ui-text-strong

variables.description: Body text color. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-text-strength-light` or `--ui-text-strength-dark`.
variables.name: text/ui-text

variables.description: Secondary text: placeholders, field helper text, overlines, descriptions in `List` and `Menu` items, unselected `Tabs` labels and `Table` captions. `--ui-text` unless a theme sets it.
variables.name: text/ui-text-subtle

variables.description: Text color of disabled buttons and chips. `--ui-text` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-text-disabled-strength`. Also the label and border of an unchecked disabled `ToggleButton`.
variables.name: text/ui-text-disabled

variables.description: Text color on `--ui-surface-inverse`.
variables.name: text/ui-on-inverse

variables.description: Text on an intent fill: an intent color with its lightness capped so light text reads on it, within `--ui-accent-fill-max-lightness` for critical `Button`s and the critical, info, neutral and success `Badge`, and within `--ui-choice-fill-max-lightness` for the invalid choice mark and the checked one in dark mode. Near-white in both modes. The fill has no token of its own, since each intent is one. Not `--ui-palette-on-strong`, which turns dark in dark mode for the light `--ui-palette-strong`.
variables.name: text/ui-on-fill

variables.description: Page and card background.
variables.name: surfaces/ui-surface

variables.description: Background of elevated cards and accordions, dialogs, drawers, menus and native `Select` options.
variables.name: surfaces/ui-surface-elevated

variables.description: Background of filled areas: lists, `.ui-filled` progress and range tracks, table headers and footers, and hovered table rows.
variables.name: surfaces/ui-surface-filled

variables.description: Background of `Tooltip`, the `Carousel` buttons and `kbd`, `var`, `.ui-kbd` and `.ui-var`, inverted against the page.
variables.name: surfaces/ui-surface-inverse

variables.description: Background of tonal variants.
variables.name: surfaces/ui-surface-tonal

variables.description: Hover fill of a `--ui-surface-tonal` surface: clickable `Chip`s, filled `TextField`, `Select` and `Textarea` fields, and tonal `Button`s with `--ui-button-hover: shade-all`. Derived from `--ui-surface-tonal`, darker in light mode and lighter in dark mode.
variables.name: surfaces/ui-surface-tonal-hover

variables.description: Default border width for components that draw a border.
variables.name: borders/ui-border-width

variables.description: Width of emphasized rules: the head and foot rules of rich text tables, the `AvatarGroup` ring, the `Badge` border, the neutral `Chip` dot, the dotted `DescriptionList` rule, the `Tabs` indicator, the bar on a selected `List` row, the `Spinner` ring, and at one and a half times, the blockquote bar.
variables.name: borders/ui-border-width-thick

variables.description: Corner radius for every component: cards, callouts, menus, buttons and fields follow it, and small parts like `kbd`, tooltips and checkboxes never get rounder than it. Set it to `0` for square corners. Takes a single length.
variables.name: borders/ui-radius

variables.description: The pill radius for round buttons, avatars, badges, the chip dot, radios, switches, the range track and the carousel buttons and markers.
variables.name: borders/ui-radius-round

variables.description: Corner radius for large surfaces, such as cards and dialogs that want more rounding than controls. `--ui-radius` times 1.5, so `0` still squares it. Not read by a component yet.
variables.name: borders/ui-radius-large

variables.description: Corner radius of small parts: `kbd`, inline `code`, `mark`, `var`, `Tooltip`, the file input and a `rounded` `Avatar`. `--ui-radius`, capped at 5px.
variables.name: borders/ui-radius-small

variables.description: Corner radius of the `Checkbox` box. `--ui-radius`, capped at 2px.
variables.name: borders/ui-radius-x-small

variables.description: Default border color for cards, lists, tables and dividers. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-border-strength-light` or `--ui-border-strength-dark`.
variables.name: borders/ui-border-color

variables.description: Border color inside filled surfaces: lists without a variant and table headers. `List` and `Table` set `--ui-border-color` to it on those parts.
variables.name: borders/ui-border-color-on-filled

variables.description: Borders drawn inside a raised surface (tonal and elevated `Card` and `Accordion`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Menu`, the `Select` picker and tonal `Callout` without a severity): dividers, separators, outlined controls. The same mix as `--ui-border-color` by default. Each raised component sets `--ui-border-color` to it on its root, so a theme that wants another border inside raised surfaces sets this one. The edge of the surface itself is `--ui-border-color-raised`.
variables.name: borders/ui-border-color-on-raised

variables.description: The edge of every raised surface: tonal and elevated `Card`, `Accordion` and `Dialog`, tonal `Callout` without a severity, `Drawer`, `Menu` and the `Select` picker. Set it to outline them all at once, or to `transparent` to drop their edges. When unset, each keeps its own edge: cards, accordions and dialogs the page background, so they stay visible on tonal surfaces, callouts their tonal background, and drawers, menus and the picker `--ui-border-color-on-raised`. The borders inside a raised surface are `--ui-border-color-on-raised`.
variables.name: borders/ui-border-color-raised

variables.description: Horizontal padding inside `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields. When unset, `--ui-space-2`. `.ui-large` reads `--ui-field-padding-inline-large`.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-padding-inline

variables.description: Horizontal padding inside `TextField`, `Textarea` and `Select` fields with `.ui-large`. When unset, `--ui-space-3`.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-padding-inline-large

variables.description: Border width for fields, `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch`.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-border-width

variables.description: Text color for helper and end text under a field.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-helper-text-color

variables.description: Font size for helper and end text under a field.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-helper-font-size

variables.description: Line height for helper and end text under a field.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-helper-line-height

variables.description: Text color for field labels.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-label-text-color

variables.description: Font size for field labels.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-label-font-size

variables.description: Font weight for emphasized field labels and legends.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-label-font-weight

variables.description: Color of the required asterisk.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-required-text-color

variables.description: Border color of every empty control: `TextField`, `Select`, `Textarea`, the unchecked `Checkbox`, `Radio` and `Switch` unless `--ui-choice-border-color` is set, the `Range` track and the `Progress` outline. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface` at `--ui-field-border-strength`, so it reaches 3:1. Lighter than `--ui-border-color`, which is decorative, is a choice a theme can make.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-border-color

variables.description: Field border color inside filled surfaces: lists without a variant and table headers. `--ui-text-strong` mixed into `--ui-surface-filled` at `--ui-field-border-strength`.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-border-color-on-filled

variables.description: Field border color inside raised surfaces. The same mix as `--ui-field-border-color` by default. Each raised component sets `--ui-field-border-color` to it on its root.
variables.name: field-input/ui-field-border-color-on-raised

variables.description: Border width of a focused `Checkbox` and `Radio` and of the field of a focused `NumberField`, `Select`, `Textarea` and `TextField`, so the focus edge thickens, like GOV.UK's 4px and Material 3's 2dp outlined fields. Never thinner than `--ui-choice-border-width` or `--ui-field-border-width`, and the extra width grows inward, so the check, the dot and the text keep their place. Forced colors keep the wider border. When wider than the ring, it is also the bar under a highlighted link, with `--ui-link-focus` set to `highlight`. When unset, the border keeps its width.
variables.name: focus-ring/ui-focus-border-width

variables.description: Distance between a control and its focus ring.
variables.name: focus-ring/ui-focus-ring-offset

variables.description: Width of the focus ring. `3px` with more contrast.
variables.name: focus-ring/ui-focus-ring-width

variables.description: Border color of a focused `Button`, `Checkbox`, `Chip`, `Radio`, `Switch` and `ToggleButton`, of the field of a focused `NumberField`, `Select`, `Textarea` and `TextField`, and of a checkbox or radio card and a `Card` with a focused card link. It gives the focus ring a second color to sit on, like a dark edge under a bright ring, so pair it with `--ui-focus-ring-offset: 0px`. When set, the focus ring promises its contrast against this border instead of the page. Links and buttons that highlight, with `--ui-link-focus` or `--ui-button-focus` set to `highlight`, show neither the ring nor this border: `--ui-on-focus-highlight` carries their contrast. When unset, each keeps its own border. Forced colors ignore it.
variables.name: focus-ring/ui-focus-border-color

variables.description: Color of the keyboard focus ring. Black on surfaces lighter than OKLCH 0.6 and white on darker ones, so it reaches 3:1 on any `--ui-surface`.
variables.name: focus-ring/ui-focus-ring-color

variables.description: Negative offset for focus rings drawn inside a control, such as `ButtonGroup`, `List` items and `Select` options.
variables.name: focus-ring/ui-focus-ring-inset

variables.description: Fill of a focused link or button that highlights instead of showing the ring, when `--ui-link-focus` or `--ui-button-focus` is `highlight`: `--ui-focus-ring-color` made opaque. A translucent ring, like Bootstrap's, fills at full strength, since text contrast on a see-through fill depends on what is behind it.
variables.name: focus-ring/ui-focus-highlight

variables.description: Text color on `--ui-focus-highlight`, and the bar under a highlighted link: black or white, whichever reads on it. It switches at OKLCH lightness 0.57, where black and white both reach 4.5:1 on a gray, since it colors text; the focus ring switches at 0.6, which only needs 3:1. Set it to match a brand's focus text, and hand it back under more contrast with the ring color.
variables.name: focus-ring/ui-on-focus-highlight

variables.description: Font family for body text, fields and buttons. `system-ui, sans-serif` by default.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-body

variables.description: Font family for `code`, `kbd`, `samp` and `pre` in rich text, `.ui-kbd`, `.ui-samp`, `.ui-var`, code blocks and `kbd` in buttons and lists. A monospace stack by default.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-code

variables.description: The smallest step of the type scale, 12px. `--ui-font-size-caption` reads it. Set the steps to reshape every size at once, or a role to move one.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-100

variables.description: Type scale step, 14px. `--ui-font-size-small` reads it.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-200

variables.description: Type scale step, 16px. `--ui-font-size-body`, `--ui-font-size-control` and `--ui-font-size-h6` read it.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-300

variables.description: Type scale step, 18px. `--ui-font-size-h5` reads it, and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows from it.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-400

variables.description: Type scale step, 20px. `--ui-font-size-large` reads it, `--ui-font-size-h3` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h4` grows to it.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-500

variables.description: Type scale step, 24px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows from it and `--ui-font-size-h3` grows to it.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-600

variables.description: Type scale step, 32px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows from it.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-700

variables.description: Type scale step, 40px. `--ui-font-size-h2` grows to it.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-800

variables.description: The largest step of the type scale, 56px. `--ui-font-size-h1` grows to it.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-size-900

variables.description: Font weight for body text, `List` text and `Button` keyboard shortcuts.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-weight-normal

variables.description: Font weight for badges, overlines and group labels.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-weight-medium

variables.description: Font weight for labels, table headers and titles.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-weight-semibold

variables.description: Font weight for headings, buttons and terms.
variables.name: typography/ui-font-weight-bold

variables.description: Letter spacing of uppercase text: overlines and the first paragraph of an `hgroup`. Scales with the font size: the value is at 16px.
variables.name: typography/ui-letter-spacing-caps

variables.description: Letter spacing of `h1` and `h2`, tighter than the body.
variables.name: typography/ui-letter-spacing-display

variables.description: Letter spacing of `h3` and `h4`, slightly tighter than the body.
variables.name: typography/ui-letter-spacing-heading

variables.description: Line height of single-line controls and compact text: field inputs, dense `Table` cells, the `Stat` value, `Tooltip`, `Card` captions and keyboard hints in buttons.
variables.name: typography/ui-line-height-tight

variables.description: Line height of interface text: labels, helpers, choice labels and field hints.
variables.name: typography/ui-line-height-control

variables.description: Line height of captions, `List` text, the `Stat` label and description and the `Stepper` description. Body text and prose use `--ui-line-height-relaxed`.
variables.name: typography/ui-line-height

variables.description: Line height of the page text set on `html`, and of `Tabs` labels.
variables.name: typography/ui-line-height-relaxed

variables.description: Vertical rhythm unit. Rich text margins and heading line heights round to it.
variables.name: typography/ui-rhythm-step

variables.description: Space between paragraphs, lists, blockquotes, tables, `details` and `address` in `.ui-rich-text`, rounded to `--ui-rhythm-step`. Headings, code blocks, figures and `hr` take multiples of it, with more room above headings than below. When unset, `1.25em` of the rich text font size.
variables.name: typography/ui-flow-gap

variables.description: Space above `h1` to `h6` in `.ui-rich-text`, rounded to `--ui-rhythm-step`. It overlaps the margin of the block before, so `0px` leaves the paragraph gap. Give a length: a unitless `0` drops both margins. `em` is the heading's own font size, so larger headings get more room, and `rem` gives every level the same space. When unset, each level takes a multiple of `--ui-flow-gap`: 3 above `h1` and `h2`, 2 above `h3` and 1.5 above `h4` to `h6`. A heading group keeps its own spacing. Scales with the font size: the value is at 16px.
variables.name: typography/ui-heading-margin-block-start

variables.description: Space below `h1` to `h6` in `.ui-rich-text`, rounded to `--ui-rhythm-step`. `em` is the heading's own font size, so larger headings get more room, and `rem` gives every level the same space. When unset, each level takes a multiple of `--ui-flow-gap`: 1 under `h1`, 0.75 under `h2` and 0.5 under `h3` to `h6`. A heading group keeps its own spacing. Scales with the font size: the value is at 16px.
variables.name: typography/ui-heading-margin-block-end

variables.description: Gap between text and its underline for `Link`, rich text links and `Stepper` links. Scales with the font size: the value is at 16px.
variables.name: typography/ui-underline-offset

variables.description: Gap between text and the underline of `abbr`, `dfn`, `ins` and `u` and their classes.
variables.name: typography/ui-underline-offset-small

variables.description: Underline thickness of `Link` and rich text links on hover and keyboard focus. At rest they keep the font's own thickness. Scales with the font size: the value is at 16px.
variables.name: typography/ui-underline-thickness-hover

variables.description: Font weight of `.ui-link` and of links in `.ui-rich-text`. When unset, links follow `--ui-font-weight-bold`, the weight of headings.
variables.name: typography/ui-link-font-weight

variables.description: Font size of captions, `Badge`, `Chip`, `Divider` labels, `List` secondary text, `Menu` shortcuts, overlines, `small`, `figcaption` and x-small buttons, toggles and fields. Defaults to `--ui-font-size-100`.
